$comment: Single source of truth for the fork's identity. Product name SKYCOT chosen 21 October 2026 (Foreman was the build-time placeholder). Changing a value = edit this file + `apps/desktop/package.json` productName (the one JSON seam), then run `node nondev/scripts/apply-brand.ts` to confirm. Runtime values are injected as T3CODE_* environment defaults by `nondev/brand/env.cjs`; upstream code keeps its own defaults, so every seam stays upstreamable.

updates.$comment: Where the Mac app looks for new SKYCOT versions. The ONLY source: env.cjs hands it on as T3CODE_SKYCOT_UPDATE_FEED; the desktop build bakes it into the app, the app refuses any other feed, and T3 Code's releases are refused everywhere (packages/skycot-brand/src/updateFeed.ts). null = no updates (today: there is no public, signed Mac download yet; the private repo above cannot serve one). To switch on, see docs/nondev/UPDATES.md: "https://downloads.skycot.com/mac/" for the beta (Cloudflare R2; a folder serving latest-mac.yml + the signed zip/dmg; see docs/nondev/RELEASE.md) or "github:<owner>/<public-repo>". updateRepository above is the source repo (the CLI `update` command and Advanced mode's release links), not the app's feed.

telemetry.$comment: Leave both null until we own a PostHog project. While they are null, enabling telemetry at runtime sends nothing (an empty key is rejected locally) rather than reporting into upstream's project.
